rationale: Round 2 shows near-total hardening around the same incompatible red lines: labor and Lower Saxony reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management and investors insist on them remaining on the table unless equivalent savings are proven. There is process-level agreement on needing numbers and a durable future, but the core dispute over closures, guarantees, and the burden of adjustment remains unresolved and is now circling.
